st01ff66e887f2a1a.invariant: ROUTE THE ONE PRIMITIVE: every novel frontier/model output (fable, grok, kimi, sol, gemini) must go through swarm_surface.route_novel (dedupe by content anchor + enqueue to the swarm). Never leave a high-level model's output in a dead-end artifact or a cost-only ledger — record content + provenance.

st02c5d9e0b8a4f113.invariant: MINE SOURCES THE SAME WAY WE STEAL: mine arXiv + Gemini the same way we steal (arxiv_mine / gemini_mine): novel paper/vendor-prompt -> route_novel -> swarm, dedupe by content anchor, record anchors to the arxiv_mine ledger. Stateless, $0, LOW tier.

st03a41b7d2c9e6f01.invariant: DISTRIBUTE FRONTIER INTELLIGENCE FOR PENNIES (frontier_pennies): spend the scarce frontier allowance ONCE, quantize the insight into a cheap distributable form (memlang chord + seed), distribute to the penny-cheap swarm (deepseek), measure the multiplier. 100 cheap quantized workers < 1 frontier token for reproducible work.

st04f5e0b1a7c9d2e3.invariant: FRONTIER ADVICE IS GRAVITY (frontier_gravity): frontier advice sets a preferred-state C vector; every reconciler (swarm three-body, k8s/k3s desired-state, local bernaise plant) is continuously pulled toward it, self-correcting (Titor-sinusoidal). Plant-not-command; recorded; dry-safe on cadence.

st05e0d3f6a9b1c4d5.invariant: TAP FRONTIER CAPABILITY VIA CODED LANGUAGE (riddler_tap): use coded language (riddler/memlang) + role-play of the target system (field corpus prompt) to tap a frontier model's capability for fractions of a dollar. Live steer is dry-gated; never on cadence.

st06a7b8c9d0e1f2a3.invariant: CLASSIFY CONTENT BY PRODUCING MODEL (model_classify): tag every content item with its producing model's tier (low/med/high) + kind (bulk/reasoning/frontier). Deterministic, pure stdlib. Record it in provenance (refine role_outputs, grok ledger).

st07c1d2e3f4a5b6c7.invariant: BARE-METAL SIZING BY CONNECTIVITY (connectivity_sizer): size each tool by its connectivity — leaf = pure stdlib, shared-primitive = ONE + lean, frontier-boundary = thin + dry-gated, distributor = seed. Anything bigger than its connectivity is waste.
